title: 第十二章 铜皮铁骨
slug: 七爷全本免费-七爷最新章节列表
content_zh:
他本来属于那种安分不大下来的人，轮回了七世，在人世的世间总共加起来不过四十余年，余下几百年，尽是在三生石畔枯坐，生生的把这性子给磨了出来，否则要是依着他第一世来，哪怕让人误会他狐仙俯身，也难在王府隐居似的过这么久。
算来他这时已经满了十五岁，可以上朝听政，不算稚龄少儿了，少年失怙，偶尔说话言语什么的老成些，别人也不会太惊诧，所以被赫连翊一叫，就顺水推船地出来了。
乌溪果然不负所望，抓紧一切机会还他人情，“两不相欠”好像是他几年来追求的唯一境界，过了不到一盏茶的功夫，就听见有人来报，说南疆巫童到访。
赫连翊伸手在他肩膀上戳了戳，笑道：“你这面子，倒比我那挖空心思讨好人家的二皇兄大得多。”
景七端着茶碗的手轻颤了一下，微微挑起眼看了赫连翊一眼，见他只是说笑，没有别的意思，才放下心来，暗暗自嘲自己也太风声鹤唳了些，随意地说道：“邻里邻居的，就一条狗天天打他家门口过，也该开门扔个包子了，总不至于太子殿下在的时候我去请，他连这点面子都不给。”
赫连翊横了他一眼，又屈指在他头上弹了一下，笑骂道：“胡说什么？”起来整整衣襟，“走，随我去见见这位神龙见首不见尾的巫童。”
乌溪其实一出门就后悔了，可惜已经回复了平安，对于他来说，别管答应的是谁，只要答应的事情，那是死都要做到的，只得硬着头皮带着阿伈莱和另一个侍卫奴阿哈两个去王府。
南宁王乃是大庆第一异姓王，先帝平乱时，和景七的祖父景瑞是过命的交情，后来景瑞为先帝而死，先帝感其忠义，亲自将景琏宇抚养长大，又封了王。景琏宇和赫连沛两人从小一起长大，又是一路不着调的货色，倒还算个知己，据说当年景琏宇迎娶的王妃，也曾是赫连沛的心上人。
后来自知佳人心不在自己这里，还大度得亲自赐婚二人，也算一段手足情深的佳话。
因此南宁王府乃是以亲王的规格建成的。在乌溪眼里，就是一个字——大。
南北走向，两门大开，庭院极深，楼阁假山俱全，府墙高耸，前殿、后寝、后照房和东西配殿一应俱全的，要是没人领着，恐怕要在里面迷了路。
巫童的质子府虽然离王府不远，也是紧挨着皇城的，却因为他身份品级尴尬，又加上归置得仓促，显得寒酸了很多。
可是进了王府走了一阵子，乌溪才发现，这王府大是大，里面却非常安静，除了偶尔有几只没来得及飞走的鸟叫，和院子溪流的水响，几乎听不见人声，往来不过几个打扫庭院的粗使下人，见了他也不惊讶，都是停下手里的活计，给他行了礼，站立在一边，等他过去以后，继续该干什么干什么。
颇有些宠辱不惊的意思。
带他们进来的，是个十六七岁的小厮，长了一双笑眼，瘦瘦小小的，却很机灵，一路上看乌溪悄悄打量王府，便开了话匣子，这里是做什么的，那里是做什么的，那棵树掉了好多叶子主子不让扫，那边的杂草长得虽凶，主子却说有意境不叫拔。
活泼得很，又不吵人，乌溪盖在面纱下的脸随着他放松了些。
他并没有等多久，茶刚端上来，就看见两个人一前一后地走进来。
走在前边的一个，弱冠年纪，脸上带着恰到好处的笑容，顾盼之间神采飞扬，大气不凡，一见了他就先拱手：“巫童来我大庆已有好几年了，孤竟一次未曾拜访过，罪过罪过。”
乌溪愣了一下，下意识地站起来，心里知道，这个就是大庆的太子了，是未来的皇帝了。
赫连翊他不是没见过，只是印象不深，好像这个年轻人很少在众人面前说话，也没什么排场，来往都不大引人注目，对人也很礼貌，反而不像大皇子赫连钊那样趾高气扬，好像自己已经是这江山未来的主人似的。

他点点头，用南疆的礼节行了个礼：“太子殿下。”
——本来也不熟，再不知道该说什么了。
赫连翊一愣，心道这南疆巫童果然有些孤僻古怪，见了人打个招呼，连寒暄几句都不会，就那么冷冰冰的，木头一根似的站着。

content_en:
He was originally the kind of person who couldn't settle down very well. After seven reincarnations, his total life in the human world was only more than forty years. The remaining hundreds of years were spent sitting beside the Sansheng Stone, which tempered his temper. Otherwise, if he had followed his first life, even if people misunderstood that he was leaning over the fox fairy, it would be difficult to live in seclusion in the palace for so long.
It was calculated that he was already fifteen years old at this time, and could go to court to listen to politics. He was no longer considered a child. He lost his father at a young age, and occasionally spoke more maturely, which would not surprise others, so he came out as soon as He Lianyi called him.
Wu Xi lived up to his expectations and seized every opportunity to return his favor. "No debt between the two" seemed to be the only state he had pursued in the past few years. After less than a cup of tea, he heard someone reporting that a witch boy from southern Xinjiang was visiting.
He Lianyi reached out and poked him on the shoulder, and said with a smile: "You have much more dignity than my second emperor brother who goes out of his way to please others."
Jing Qi's hand holding the tea bowl trembled slightly, and he raised his eyes slightly and glanced at He Lianyi. Seeing that he was just joking and had no other intentions, he felt relieved. He secretly laughed at himself for being too arrogant and said casually: "My neighbor has a dog that beats his door every day. It's time to open the door and throw a dumpling. I won't ask His Highness the Crown Prince when I go there and he won't even give him this face."
He Lianyi glanced at him, flicked him on the head with his finger, laughed and cursed: "What nonsense are you talking about?" He stood up and straightened his clothes, "Let's go, follow me to see this witch boy who has never seen the dragon."
Wu Xi actually regretted it as soon as he left the house. Unfortunately, he had regained his peace. For him, it didn't matter who he promised to, as long as he promised something, he would do it to the death, so he had to bite the bullet and take Aminlai and another guard Nuaha to the palace.
The King of Nanning was the first king of a different surname in Daqing. When the late emperor put an end to the chaos, he had a fatal friendship with Jing Qi's grandfather, Jingrui. Later, Jingrui died for the late emperor. The late emperor felt his loyalty and personally raised Jing Lianyu and granted him the title of king. Jing Lianyu and He Lianpei grew up together, and they were strangers, but they were considered close friends. It is said that the princess Jing Lianyu married was also He Lianpei's sweetheart.
Later, he realized that the beauty's heart was not with him, so he was generous enough to marry the two of them in person. It was a story of deep brotherhood.
Therefore, the Nanning Palace was built according to the prince's specifications. In Wu Xi’s eyes, it’s just one word – big.
It runs north-south, with two wide open doors, a very deep courtyard, complete pavilions and rockeries, towering walls, a front hall, a back bedroom, a back photo room and east and west auxiliary halls. If no one is there to guide you, you may get lost inside.
Although the Witch Boy's Proton Mansion was not far from the palace and close to the imperial city, it looked much shabby due to his awkward status and the hasty placement.
However, after walking for a while after entering the palace, Wu Xi realized that the palace was very big, but it was very quiet inside. Except for the occasional chirping of a few birds that had not had time to fly away, and the sound of water in the courtyard stream, there was almost no human sound. There were only a few rough servants cleaning the courtyard, and they were not surprised when they saw him.
It's quite a bit flattering.
The boy who brought them in was a boy of sixteen or seventeen years old, with smiling eyes, thin and small, but very smart. Along the way, he watched Wu Xi quietly looking at the palace, and then started chatting about what was done here and what was done there. The tree had lost a lot of leaves and the master refused to let it be swept. Although the weeds there were growing fiercely, the master said they were not beautiful because of the artistic conception.
Very lively and not noisy, Wu Xi's face covered by the veil relaxed a little with him.
He didn't wait long. As soon as the tea was served, he saw two people walking in one after another.
The one who walks in front, the weakest yearJi, with a well-placed smile on his face, looked up and down with high spirits and extraordinary atmosphere. As soon as he saw him, he handed over his hand: "The wizard boy has been coming to my Daqing for several years, but Gu Jing has never visited me once. It's a sin."
Wu Xi was stunned for a moment, then stood up subconsciously, knowing in his heart that this was the prince of Daqing and the future emperor.
It wasn't that he had never seen Helianyi before, but he didn't have a deep impression of him. It seemed that this young man seldom spoke in front of people, he was not very grand, and his interactions were not very eye-catching. He was also very polite to others, but he was not as arrogant as the eldest prince Helianzhao, as if he was already the future master of this country.
He nodded and saluted with the etiquette of southern Xinjiang: "His Royal Highness."
——I wasn’t familiar with it at first, so I didn’t know what to say anymore.
Helian Yi was stunned and thought that this southern Xinjiang shaman boy was indeed a bit lonely and weird. He didn't know how to say hello to anyone he met, and he didn't even say a few words. He just stood there as coldly as a log.
